senses.gloss:
बैदल बैदल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. बिदल, q. v.),
made of split bamboos, made of cane; (अस्), m. a
kind of pastry, a flat unleavened cake (= बिदल,
q. v.); a leguminous plant, pulse; (अम्), n. a vessel
made of wicker-work, basket made of reeds; a
basket; (more usually written वैदल.)
बैदलिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to pulse &c.
